title: Gout Related SNP
projectSummary: The Cerebrovascular Disease Knowledge Portal enables browsing, searching, and analysis of human genetic information linked to cerebrovascular disease and related traits, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.
dataTableFormat:
{
"data convert":[
{"type":"join", "field name":"Locus","fields to join":["CHR","POS"],"join by":":"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Reference variant","raw field":"REF"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Altered variant","raw field":"ALT"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"RSID","raw field":"RSID"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"P-Value","raw field":"PVAL"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Mapped gene","raw field":"Mapped_gene"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Reported gene","raw field":"Reported Gene(s)"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"PUBMEDID","raw field":"PUBMEDID"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Study","raw field":"Study"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Trait","raw field":"Disease/Trait"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Race","raw field":"race"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Year","raw field":"year"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Subjects","raw field":"subjects"},
{"type":"raw","field name":"Controls","raw field":"controls"},
{"type":"calculate","field name":"pval_ng_log10","raw field":"PVAL","calculation type":"-log10"}
],
"top rows":["Locus","Reference variant","Altered variant","RSID","P-Value","Mapped gene","Reported gene","Trait"],
"features":["Source", "Ancestry","Sample size"],
"Source":["Study","PUBMEDID"],
"Ancestry":["Race","Year"],
"Sample size":["Subjects","Controls"]
}
visualizerConfiguration:
{"type":"manhattan bitmap plot",
"x axis field": "Locus",
"y axis field": "pval_ng_log10",
"render by": "RSID",
"y axis label": "-Log10(p-value)",
"x axis label": "Chromosome",
"hover content": ["Locus","P-Value","Reported gene"],
"height": 300}
